_note: Game-rolled Sybil jail (unlock A5). Each POST /airdrop/claim attempt that reaches the server (a new Idempotency-Key; replays do not count) is counted per player over windowSeconds. When the count reaches a tier's minAttempts, the server rolls chanceBps (out of 10000) with a CSPRNG; the highest tier reached wins. A hit refuses that claim with 403 SYBIL_JAILED and jails for jailMinutes. Only rolls while the capability sybilBail is on. Bail = farm yield per started hour still to serve x bailYieldMultiplier, at least minBailCents, at most maxBailCents; paid to the house (a sink).
